reason: B has the more coherent visual language: the ruled handover, restrained orange marks and compact promise make an immediate restaurant-specific composition that stays readable on a phone. A demonstrates more product behaviour, but its dense walkthrough and reproducible overflow in an entered-note state need repair before shipping; a contained composer and tighter mobile rhythm would make it a closer choice.
